components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that moves the workout forward: Roll, Accept, Finish.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background: #ffb000; color: #0b0b0d; border: 1px solid #ffb000; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffc233; border-color: #ffc233; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b07800; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background: #ffffff; color: #0e0f11; border: 1px solid #b4b8bd; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f1f2f4; border-color: #686c73; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b07800; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard field with caps label above.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field span { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #474b51; } .ds-field input { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #b4b8bd; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #686c73; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #b07800; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #b07800; }

components.name: Workout Board Row
components.description: One rolled exercise: number, name, tier, reps in flap cells.
components.html: 01DIAMOND PUSH UPBEGINNER · EASY14
components.css: .ds-board { background: #0b0b0d; color: #f2f2f2; border: 1px solid #2a2d31; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px #1d1f23; padding: 4px; } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3rem 1fr 9.5rem auto; gap: 16px; align-items: center; padding: 14px 20px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; } .ds-no { color: #a7aaaf; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-name { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-tier { color: #a7aaaf; letter-spacing: 0.12em; font-size: 15px; } .ds-reps { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-reps b { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 0.82em; height: 1.35em; font-size: 40px; color: #ffb000; background: linear-gradient(#1f2024 0 50%, #17181b 50% 100%); border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: Desktop side rail; becomes a bottom tab bar on phones.
components.css: .ds-rail { width: 232px; background: #1d1f23; padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a7aaaf; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav:hover { color: #f2f2f2; background: #26292d; } .ds-active { color: #ffb000; background: #0b0b0d; }

narrative.overview: A rolled workout is a timetable for the next forty minutes. Bikkanto shows it the way a rail concourse shows departures: matte black boards, condensed white caps in fixed cells, amber for what is live, and characters that flip into place when something changes. Everything around the board is a calm steel frame with standard controls, so the athlete knows where everything is before they notice the world.
keyCharacteristics: Boards are flap black in both themes; only the frame around them changes.
Amber means "act here" or "live now": the primary action, the current nav item, column heads, reps.
Numbers are tabular and sit in fixed cells, so a reroll never shifts the layout.
One authored motion: the flap cascade, plus a short amber row lamp when a row lands or changes.

rules.name: The Board Never Changes Rule
rules.body: The light/dark toggle repaints the frame (ground, panels, inputs), never the boards. A board is an object, not a theme.

rules.name: The Amber Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only where the athlete can act or where something is live. Decoration in amber is a lie on a departure board.

rules.name: The Caps Are For The Board Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked Barlow Condensed is for labels, buttons and board text. Sentences people read stay in sentence-case Barlow.

dos: Do put workout data, stats and tables on a board.
Do keep reps in fixed flap cells so rerolls don't reflow.
Do use standard controls (selects, segmented radios, steppers, tables) inside the frame.
Do theme browser surfaces (selection, caret, focus ring, scrollbars, date picker, Handsontable) from the palette.
donts: Don't paint boards light in light mode.
Don't use amber for decoration or body text on light grounds.
Don't add kickers or eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't fake brushed metal, rivets or bevels; the frame stays flat.
Don't scatter motion: the flap cascade and row lamp are the only authored moves.
